title: Inversion for Emphasis
rule: Inversion under negative or restrictive adverbs adds dramatic emphasis.
pattern: Under no circumstances / Little / So + inversion

examples.text: Under no circumstances should data be shared.
Little did they know what awaited.
So intense was the debate that talks paused.
Not for a moment did I believe him.
Hardly had we arrived when it began to snow.

practicePrompt: Complete: Rarely ___ such a compelling argument presented.
